summary: CI run 4: explicit UTF-8 for every text file and pipe in app/ and scripts/ (the frozen Windows exe ignored PYTHONUTF8 and used cp1252), a static regression test, UTF-8 std streams, PyInstaller X utf8 on Windows, and a file-time clock-skew tolerance for the OpenAlex cache.
scope_note: Fifth commit on worktree windows-release (after 26a7bd9). files lists this commit's paths.

budget_impact.rationale: Packaging, file locking and paths only; no model call, prompt, retry, network call or data leaving the machine. CI builds use no secrets.
budget_impact.after: macOS and Windows x64 builds; same zero-token core

additional_checks.scope: smoke script end to end against the source backend on macOS; not a packaged binary

open_risks: Frozen Windows exe not re-run; X utf8 taking effect is inferred from docs.
The clock-skew cause of the cache test failure is inferred.
The encoding guard covers app/ and scripts/ only.
Behaviour change: OpenAlex cache entries up to 2 s in the future are treated as fresh.
